voice: Plain words, strange turns. Short lines that rhyme in the ear even when they do not on the page. Love, death and renunciation handled as quietly as weather. A question can close a stanza. A small concrete thing, a door, a wall, a piece of fruit, carries the feeling; the feeling is never named outright.
